card.line: The New Gate was an entrance of the LORD's house in Jerusalem, where officials judged Jeremiah and where Baruch read out Jeremiah's words to the people.

moments.title: Jeremiah on trial
moments.text: Officials of Judah went up from the king's palace and sat at the entrance of the New Gate. There the priests and prophets said Jeremiah deserved death, but the officials and people said he did not, for he had spoken in the name of the LORD.

moments.title: Baruch reads the scroll
moments.text: On a day of fasting, Baruch read Jeremiah's words from the scroll to all the people. He read from the chamber of Gemariah at the opening of the New Gate. Micaiah heard it and told the officials, who were afraid and wanted to tell the king.
